import json,requests
from collections import Counter
d=json.load(open("/work/d.json"))
v=0
for st in range(1,9):
    z=Counter(tuple(x[0]^x[i] for i in range(1,5)) for r in d[str(st)]["Z"] for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    p=Counter(sum(x)%2 for r in d[str(st)]["X"] for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    k=(st-1)*5
    for j,b in enumerate(z): v|=b<<(k+j)
    v|=p<<(k+4)
h="%010x"%v;print(h)
print(requests.post("http://154.57.164.77:40675/submit",json={"session_id":"25d6334a-6308-46ba-87cd-fa9522c4e5d7","secret_bits":h}).json())
